clues.text: Gideon was secretly threshing it in a winepress to hide it from the Midianites when the angel came.
In a parable of Jesus, an enemy came while everyone slept and sowed weeds among it in a man's field.
Jesus said a kernel of it must fall to the ground and die, or it remains only a seed.
Jesus warned Simon that Satan had asked to sift all the disciples like this.
When hail struck Egypt, the flax and barley were ruined, but this late crop and spelt survived.
Ruth gleaned with Boaz's servant girls until both the barley harvest and this harvest were finished.
John the Baptist said the coming One would gather it into His barn and burn up the chaff.
